summary: xAI launched Automations, a Grok feature that lets users schedule or trigger recurring agent jobs (e.g. email-based or time-based) that run autonomously and report back, available on grok.com and the iOS/Android app.

mechanisms.reason: The feature shifts Grok from a chat-on-demand tool to one that executes delegated tasks autonomously on a schedule or trigger, without the user issuing each request.
mechanisms.quote: Today, we're introducing Automations: jobs Grok runs on its own.

practices.reason: Describes a concrete trigger/schedule pattern for structuring recurring agent work, but it is a proprietary product surface rather than a technique an external engineering team could directly implement.
practices.quote: Email triggers watch your inbox instead. When an incoming email matches your filters (sender, recipient, or subject), the automation fires with that email as context, and Grok responds to the actual message.

practices.reason: Access to email-trigger automations is gated behind a paid tier, which is a licensing distinction relevant to anyone integrating Grok into a workflow.
practices.quote: Scheduled automations are available to everyone; email triggers are included with SuperGrok.
